About.label: ABOUT MATHEUS SULINO
About.title: A curious mind. A hands-on approach.
About.intro: I'm Matheus Sulino, a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Science student at the Federal University of Tocantins (UFT), at its Palmas campus, in Tocantins, Brazil.
About.body: My interest in technology grows through practice: understanding how an application fits together, from its interface to its data, and using code to solve concrete problems. Personal projects and academic team work at UFT have helped me explore web development and software engineering.
About.body2: I keep building on that foundation while studying and working as an IT intern at EGEFAZ. VRAS CODE brings that work together and reflects what I have built and what I am continuing to learn.
About.principle1Body: Start with the context, the people and the constraints.
About.principle2Body: Connect interfaces, application logic and data with clear responsibilities.
About.principle3Body: Test the behavior, acknowledge limitations and keep improving.
